Subject: Follow-up: scheduling demo + rotating time slots

Hi Alex 

thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Goal: run a technical demo + integration deep-dive focused on your inference throughput and multi-region routing needs.
- Ask: please confirm who from Acme should attend (engineer(s), infra/ops, security if applicable).

To make scheduling easier across your US/EU/APAC teams, I put together a couple of rotating-slot options. The idea is we run recurring 60-minute deep-dive sessions and rotate the meeting times weekly so the burden of late hours is spread across regions. Proposed pattern:

Option A (rotate weekly):
  - Week 1 (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 AM PT / Tue 1:00 PM ET / Tue 6:00 PM BST
  - Week 2 (EU-friendly): Thu 10:00 AM BST / Thu 5:00 AM PT / Thu 12:00 AM AEST
  - Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Mon 9:00 AM AEST / Sun 4:00 PM PT / Sun 7:00 PM ET

Option B (fixed alternating pair):
  - US/EU slot: Wed 11:00 AM PT / Wed 2:00 PM ET / Wed 7:00 PM BST
  - APAC slot: Mon 8:00 AM AEST / Sun 3:00 PM PT / Sun 6:00 PM ET

If you prefer, we can also do a one-off demo that fits your primary team and then set up the rotating cadence afterwards.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm preferred option (A or B) or propose specific slot(s).
2) Share a list of attendees (names + roles + timezones).
3) We’ll send a calendar invite and attach a short agenda + integration checklist.

I attached a draft agenda and an infra questions spreadsheet to help your engineers prepare.

Thanks 

I can be flexible next week to lock this in.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
(redwood-demo-agenda.pdf attached)
